keystrokes: for f in include/*.h src/*.c; do echo "===== $f ====="; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; done

cat > Makefile <<'EOF'
.RECIPEPREFIX = >
CC = cc
CFLAGS = -Wall -Wextra -g -std=c99

TARGET = lisp
SRCS = src/minilisp.c
OBJS = $(SRCS:.c=.o)

.PHONY: all clean

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS)
>$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^

src/%.o: src/%.c
>$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

clean:
>rm -f $(OBJS) $(TARGET)
EOF
timeout 15 gcc -Wall -Wextra -g -std=c99 -o lisp src/minilisp.c; echo compile_exit:$?

cat > /tmp/test.lsp <<'EOF'
(+ 1 2)

(+ -5 10)

(+ x 5)
((lambda (x) (* x x)) 5)
(if (> 5 3) 100 200)

((make-adder 10) 7)

(cond ((> 3 5) 100) ((= 2 2) 200) (t 300))
